BiblicalUsage: Pârâh is the heifer, the young cow. Israel is commanded to bring a red heifer without spot, wherein is no blemish, to be burned for the water of separation; the Philistines yoke two milch kine to a new cart to carry the ark home; and Pharaoh dreams of seven well favoured kine coming up out of the river.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the heifer carries both cleansing and return. The red heifer's ashes cleanse the unclean, and the milch kine carry the ark home to Israel.
